required_precode_gaps.counterexample: Registered LUI A is prequeried, but definitions before its lower instruction include distinct LUI B. A one-call implementation cannot discover B then query its uses without rebuilding the graph or having included B in advance. Silently ignoring B readers falsely suggests the reader set is closed.
required_precode_gaps.direction: Before the single graph call, deterministically deduplicate definitions queries for each selected lower/base register and use queries for all selected LUI candidates in the bounded scan, including registered candidates. Preserve64-query cap and explicit oversize refusal/hold. Every reaching LUI must have a matching actual query result or produce missing-uses held status. Non-LUI definitions and multiple LUIs remain their own refusals.

required_precode_gaps.counterexample: Some18 policy cases intentionally inject combined definition/use tuples that no supplied raw graph establishes. Serializing their definitions_complete=true into the public request would turn a caller-policy test into untrusted proof.
required_precode_gaps.direction: Freeze public API fields without any injected graph facts/completeness or arbitrary saved-report acceptance. Keep manual policy-order tests distinct from actual pinned ELF/entry graph tests. Independently derive realizable end-to-end goldens; record any policy case that remains unit-only rather than claiming18 full graph-backed equivalents.

required_precode_gaps.counterexample: Full code/LUI/lower collision identity and lower-reader owner identity differ. Matching a reader PC alone cannot authorize a benign pair for a different LUI. Unbound historical SHIP_PRE snippets cannot waive unknowns.
required_precode_gaps.direction: Extend the same siteOwner collection with a distinct lower-reader projection, preserving existing full-pair/memory keys and absent-option outputs. Put exact benign tuples under stable IDs with source/byte bindings. Freeze duplicate lower-owner handling and drafted/patched precedence. Do not overload Excluded/Flagged/OmitIDs or activate unbound historical waivers.

required_precode_gaps.counterexample: ORI and ADDIU with immediate0xffff produce different targets; differing lower RT/RS is valid observed flow but invalid canonical same-register patch grammar. Strict referenceTarget is called by patch.plan.
required_precode_gaps.direction: Keep canonical validator unchanged. ORI finite effects belong in existing shared decoder; inspected99byte private delta does that without new functions/types. Compute graph-backed observed target equations from actual upper/lower words and base-RS dependency, retaining signed-add versus zero-extended OR and modulo32. Reuse existing arithmetic owner where practical without importing its64-word heuristic. Do not force a generic decoder or widen patch grammar to share two arithmetic expressions.

required_precode_gaps.counterexample: An optional reference_candidates flow branch added only after registry parsing would bypass the stronger indexed/observed recipe identity rechecks and bounded-buffer publication if those predicates remain unchanged. A saved or raced input could be described by mismatched provenance.
required_precode_gaps.direction: Extend existing strict optional request policy and shared recheck/buffered lifecycle for the new additive request, including every consumed source/recipe/registry/glyph input as appropriate. Validate canonical/null/alias/duplicate keys, bounded source/entries/queries/output and forbid writes/composition. Preserve legacy absent-option outputs/refusals; no duplicate runner.

required_precode_gaps.counterexample: A known foreign reader justifies refusal even alongside unknown backward facts. Early site_plan refusal order is different from full audit diagnostics, so one success/first-error flag cannot represent both honestly.
required_precode_gaps.direction: Choose and freeze one bounded report behavior now, preferably full ordered diagnostic facts with explicit held/completeness fields. Preserve other-defs, registered absent-or-multiple, target, sorted reader and limit ordering from frozen source where applicable. Do not claim site_plan equivalence or .05 completion; reads_arg/Tracer consumers remain explicit gaps.
